title: tls: Refactor PSK key exchange
description:
Refactor dissect_ssl3_hnd_*_keyex_psk() to return the length of the
"PSK Server Params", and use this as offset to server params when
needed. This avoids the need to fetch identity/hint length twice.

tls: Refactor PSK key exchange

Refactor dissect_ssl3_hnd_*_keyex_psk() to return the length of the
"PSK Server Params", and use this as offset to server params when
needed. This avoids the need to fetch identity/hint length twice.
